Description

2025 Bowman Draft is a 200-card set released January 14th, 2026. Each Hobby only Jumbo box will contain three autographs, 24 Refractors, and eleven inserts, while Super Jumbo boxes will yield five signatures, 40 Refractors, and ten inserts.

Distribution

Jumbo: 32 cards per pack, 12 packs per box (MSRP: $519.99). Eight boxes per case. Hobby only.

Super Jumbo: 120 cards per pack, five packs per box (MSRP: $739.99). Six boxes per case. Hobby only.

HTA Choice: Three cards per box. Six boxes per case. Hobby only.

Parallels

All 200 base cards are available in the following parallels.

  • Sky Blue (serial-numbered to 499 copies)
  • Blue (serial-numbered to 150 copies)
  • Green (serial-numbered to 99 copies)
  • Gold (serial-numbered to 50 copies)
  • Orange (serial-numbered to 25 copies; Jumbo only)
  • Red (serial-numbered to five)
  • Black (one-of-one)
  • Printing Plates (set of four for each card)

NOTE: Parallels are not available in Breaker's Delight packs.

Variety Parallels

Randomly inserted into Jumbo boxes is a four-card "Variety Pack." Each pack contains one card from one of four Variety Pack-exclusive parallels: Peanut, Sunflower Seed, Bubble Gum, and Popcorn.
